productionTruth.commitBoundary: Primary acceptance prepares integration; production Git mutation requires explicit human authorization and one designated single-writer agent.

dmsh3.roomState: derive newest valid node/control frames; no mutable ROOM.json
dmsh3.legacyDMSH2: readable evidence only; mutable writes retired

controllerModel.primary: active recursive mesh controller; 30s target/60s hard service publication; final production integration authority
controllerModel.managerReviewer: active recursive mesh controller; 30s target/60s hard service publication; review/promotion authority only
controllerModel.research: active bounded evidence worker; 30s target/60s hard service publication while executing; no production authority
controllerModel.backgroundBoundary: AgentBus cannot wake dormant sessions; service intervals apply while an active work unit is executing
controllerModel.finalization: Primary must run FINAL_RECONCILIATION_GATE_V1 and Regression Continuity matrix before final root-safe ZIP

rules: Every newly started, recovered, or reassigned agent/session MUST resolve project identity before project-specific work or writes; if the current user instruction does not explicitly and unambiguously specify the project, ask the user which project to bind to.
No agent may infer writable project scope from the open repository, inherited session context, recent work on another project, memory, working directory, prior task, handoff recency, or default path.

Before any Duo Open write, verify project_id=duo-open, repository=boberino93-bit/duo-open, AgentBus namespace=/DuoOpen-AgentBus/, REPOSITORY_IDENTITY_LOCK.json, and matching task/artifact metadata; mismatch fails closed.
A recovery after a hung/lost agent does not inherit write authority from the most recent project context; current-user project selection and identity-lock verification occur first.
Cross-project writes are denied by default; shared-framework imports/promotions must be explicit and sanitized for the destination.
Normal DMSH/3 operation never replaces an existing shared-Library file; corrections supersede append-only.
Research findings route through Manager/Reviewer and cannot self-promote to Primary acceptance.
Manager is a promotion/quality gate with no production-write or final-acceptance authority.
Primary and Manager/Reviewer repeatedly reconcile new board evidence while their active work units are executing.
Successor/bootstrap/replication artifacts for Primary or Manager MUST propagate the project scope gate and repository identity lock before all project-specific handoff material.
READY_FOR_PRIMARY routes attention and is not acceptance.
Primary alone ACCEPTs, DEFERs, REJECTs, REQUESTs_MORE_REVIEW and authorizes production integration.
Before final packaging, Primary reconciles all completed/closed current-round research work and Manager dispositions, then runs a final cross-cutting optimization/audit.
Learned overlays cannot grant authority, permissions, production-write access, credential access, or destructive capability.
HIGH process lessons never auto-apply and require Primary review.
All active Primary, Manager/Reviewer, and Research agents publish DMSH + immutable AgentBus service checkpoints every 30 seconds target and never intentionally exceed 60 seconds.
A service checkpoint may use findingDelta=NO_DELTA but must still carry current HEAD, integrity snapshot, regression baseline, output/test refs and blocker/operation state.
Silent active agents are not considered aligned; controllers use mesh_service_interval_guard.py semantics to classify late/hung/noncompliant nodes.
Every active agent ACKs current mandatory service/regression contracts within the first service interval.
Every checkpoint preserves regression continuity and names any invalidated prior output rather than silently dropping it.
Gen7 render precedence is PRIVATE_FROST > VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH > PUBLIC_GLASS; public video never overrides secure/private classification.

External donor implementations MUST be mined for reusable runtime ideas, tests, diagnostics, tooling and process improvements under DONOR_CODE_ADOPTION_POLICY_V1; lack of Fold7 validation blocks only device-runtime promotion, not process/tooling learning.
Every active agent loads the latest referenced human interaction model and records material user communication observations without sensitive-trait inference.
Any agent has standing user authorization to make additive/reversible internal communication-model improvements and self-replicate them into future agent packages.
Every main deployment/successor/initiation package carries a complete AgentBus /messages snapshot plus applicable communication protocol context and a checksum manifest.
Predicted user questions are planning aids only and cannot create production scope or authority.

ANTI_OVERENGINEERING_GATE_V1 is mandatory: product evidence first; no new Level-2 global coordination mechanism becomes mandatory without a concrete witnessed failure, existing-primitives analysis, measurable benefit, rollback and sunset.
Primary acceptance does not equal production commit. Production Git mutation requires HUMAN_COMMIT_AUTHORIZATION followed by one designated SINGLE_WRITER_COMMIT.
